step_1_damage_type_and_source.claim: A `Q` event on Syndra must be magic damage.
step_1_damage_type_and_source.result: damage_type="magic", source="Q", phase="ability" are all consistent. PASS

step_2_magnitude.verified_against_game_files: data/staleness.json -> champions.Syndra: stale=false, ability_rows_stale=0, note "Q[0] Magic Damage matched BaseDamage" (patch 16.15)
step_2_magnitude.result: 650.0 lands EXACTLY on Syndra Q's damage lattice for an integer AP at every rank (600/650/700/750/800). docs/math-foundations.md Section 5 pins `calculate_total_stats` to 'display-level integer rounding of health/AD/AP/armor/MR before damage', so an integer AP is exactly what the engine feeds the scaling - i.e. 650.0 is a value Q can actually produce, not an arbitrary float. PASS
step_2_magnitude.mitigation_check: docs/math-foundations.md 2.1: post = raw x 100/(100+R). A damage_event's `damage` field is post-mitigation (data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json e9-e5-veigar-primordial-burst: raw_damage 325.0 -> damage 213.8 vs 52 MR). Solving 650 = raw x 100/(100+MR) with raw on the Q lattice and integer AP forces MR_effective to be a multiple of 7 (65*MR/7 must be an integer); MR_effective = 0 (a manual target with no MR, or full magic pen) is the only natural solution, giving raw = post = 650. PASS/consistent.

step_3_no_transcendence_buff_active.claim: The value proves Syndra's 120-splinter Transcendence (+15% AP) is NOT applied to this cast, which is self-consistent for a scenario at 60 splinters.
step_3_no_transcendence_buff_active.source: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.P effects: 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%'; data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json -> Syndra: 'splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage'
step_3_no_transcendence_buff_active.check: With the buff, 650 = base + 0.70 x 1.15 x AP gives AP in {695.65, 652.17, 608.70, 565.22, 521.74} - not an integer at any rank. Without the buff every rank yields an integer AP. So the leaf is consistent with splinters < 120 (e.g. the scenario's 60), and inconsistent with an erroneously applied capstone buff. PASS
step_3_no_transcendence_buff_active.also: At 60 splinters the W Transcendent bonus is true damage; this event is magic, so it is not a mis-attributed W true-damage packet.

step_4_should_the_event_exist_at_all.model: docs/math-foundations.md 1.1: 'Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline ... an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window'; Section 5 row 'Ability rotation casts (_schedule_shared_casts, _compute_ability_rotation) | shared-timeline renewal schedule; cast starts within window | EXACT', with the documented model constraint 'R casts exactly once per timed fight'.

sourced_cooldowns.Q: 7 / 7 / 7 / 7 / 7 (data/champions.json Syndra.Q.cooldown; affectedByCdr=false; rechargeRate [7]x5; 2 charges at 40+ splinters per the Transcendent bonus)

step_4_should_the_event_exist_at_all.conclusion: A 60-second Syndra fight cannot contain only 10 damage events. Cast times are at most 0.25 s (E, R; Q and W are castTime 'none'), so shared-timeline mutual exclusion cannot compress 22+ cast epochs down to 10. The OLD baseline (array length exactly 10, nothing at or after t = 10.0 s) is therefore under-populated for this window; growing the array is the direction the sourced model demands. The added event is required, not spurious.

step_5_the_timestamp.check: t = 10.0 is not a multiple of Q's unhasted 7 s cooldown (epochs 0, 7, 14, ...).
step_5_the_timestamp.reconciliation: Syndra's R passive explicitly grants Q ability haste: 'Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste' = 10 / 20 / 30 (data/champions.json Syndra.R effects[0]). With effective_cooldown = cd x 100/(100+AH) (docs/math-foundations.md Section 5, EXACT), 40 total ability haste on Q gives 7 x 100/140 = 5.000 s exactly, whose epochs are 0, 5, 10, 15, ... - t = 10.0 is the third Q cast. 40 AH = R rank 3 (30) + 10 item/rune haste, or R rank 2 (20) + 20 haste.
step_5_the_timestamp.cross_check_of_the_scheduling_convention: The same convention is visible in the verified corpus: data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json e9-e8-rengar-battle-roar-grey (time_based, 16 s, no items) shows Battle Roar events at t = 0.0 and t = 10.0, and Rengar W rank 5 cooldown is 10 (data/champions.json) - i.e. events land at exact multiples of the effective cooldown, 0, cd, 2cd, ... So an event at a clean 10.0 s is the engine's ordinary epoch arithmetic, not a fabricated timestamp.
step_5_the_timestamp.residual_uncertainty: The scenario's cast order, ranks, AP and ability haste live outside the evidence tree (scenario fixtures are not under data/; data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json contains no Syndra scenario). I therefore verify the magnitude exactly and the existence of the event decisively, while t = 10.0 is verified as *attainable and conventional* (exactly 40 ability haste on Q, or the custom order's queueing) rather than uniquely pinned. Nothing in the sourced data contradicts it; a 7 s unhasted Q would put the cast at 14.0 instead, which is the only competing reading and one that cannot produce a shorter old array either.

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts). With c_i the effective cooldown of ability i, the cast epochs of a solo ability are 0, c_i, 2c_i, ...

Ability haste (effective_cooldown) | cd' = cd*100/(100+AH) ... EXACT | R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)  ///  Stat rounding (calculate_total_stats) | display-level integer rounding of health/AD/AP/armor/MR before damage
m(R) = 100 / (100 + R) (apply_resistance, resistance.py); post = raw * m(R)

"E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers."

conclusion: 650.0 magic damage from Syndra's Q is exactly reproducible from the patch-16.15 wiki row 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP) at an integer AP (600 at rank 5, 650/700/750/800 at ranks 4..1) with no magic resistance in the way, and it is inconsistent with an erroneously applied 120-splinter +15% AP capstone - i.e. the number is right and is applying the right buff set. Independently, the sourced cooldowns (Q 7, W 8-12, E 15, R 80-120) put a floor of ~22 damaging ability casts in a 60-second window, so the old 10-event array was structurally short and the array had to grow. The timestamp 10.0 s is the third epoch of a Q at exactly 40 ability haste (7 x 100/140 = 5.0 s), which Syndra's own R passive supplies 10/20/30 of, and matches the engine's demonstrated 0/cd/2cd epoch convention (Rengar W at 0.0 and 10.0). No sourced value contradicts any field of the new leaf.
